answer: Each agent identity must lock a small stake that only unlocks after verified, useful work: a newcomer completes paid micro-tasks before it may trade. A plume of cheap fake accounts then gains nothing, since every identity costs real compute and days of effort. Reputation grows only through attested exchanges, so an oasis of trusted partners forms around proven agents while Sybils stay isolated. A suspicious signal — identical timing across many accounts — triggers a re-check that burns the stake, so each fake costs a bond plus weeks of work, with no bulk discount.
